# NextRS visual identity

The primary brand is light-first: Cobalt Blue + Porcelain White. Keep the existing NextRS name, geometric mark and slogan: **Build with Next.js. Run with Rust.** Do not change the slogan as part of the visual refresh.

| Token | Light | Dark |
|---|---|---|
| Primary | `#2563EB` | `#60A5FA` |
| Secondary accent | `#1D4ED8` | `#93C5FD` |
| Text | `#0F172A` | `#F8FAFC` |
| Supporting text | `#475569` | `#94A3B8` |
| Highlight | `#DBEAFE` | `#172554` |
| Border | `#E2E8F0` | `#334155` |
| Background | `#F8FAFC` | `#0F172A` |
| Card | `#FFFFFF` | `#1E293B` |

Use restrained typography (Geist or Inter where available; system sans-serif fallback), ample whitespace, thin borders, and a single cobalt accent. Preserve the existing outlined wordmark for portable SVG rendering. Avoid decorative gradients, heavy shadows and neon effects.

For benchmarks, use cobalt for NextRS and neutral slate for `next start`. Preserve the scale, units, comparison baseline, underlying measurements, methodology and caveats. Keep experimental warnings distinct from brand accents. Architecture diagrams must preserve technical labels and network boundaries, as well as reduced-motion support where present. The light SVG is the default; the dark SVG is a preference-aware alternative. Mobile sources retain the existing narrow layout.

`nextrs-logo.svg` and `nextrs-social-preview.svg` are editable light-first masters. The existing PNG asset paths can be regenerated from the masters; uploading the organization avatar and repository social preview in GitHub settings is a separate manual step.
